'''Withering Frontline''' is an area of [[Desorock Highland]], [[Huanglong]]. 

==Description==
The Withering Frontline is a massive [[Tacet Field]] heavily populated with dangerous [[Tacet Discord]]s. Unique flora such as [[Erodorchid]]s can be found here such as a result.

==Features==
The [[Gallery#Sceneries|Viewpoint]] "Raindrops of the Past" is found on the southern edge of the Withering Frontline.
